title: To Roman numerals
hints: Validate the range first. Then think greedily: repeatedly take the largest value that still fits into `n`, write its symbol, and subtract it.

Treat the subtractive pairs as symbols of their own. Two parallel tables do it: `values := []int{1000, 900, 500, 400, 100, 90, 50, 40, 10, 9, 5, 4, 1}` and the matching `symbols := []string{"M", "CM", "D", ...}`.
`for i, v := range values { for n >= v { sb.WriteString(symbols[i]); n -= v } }` and finally `return sb.String(), nil`.
